_doc: SLOP-4: widget-reporter text (the submission message, the reporter page's replies) is UNTRUSTED plain text. The SERVER escapes it into GFM that renders as the literal text on every client (web lib/reporter-text.ts escapeReporterText; the migration 0158's pg_temp.slop4_escape is its SQL twin), so no renderer needs a plain-text branch and no mention / issue-ref / autolink ever fires on it. Rules, in order: backslash first, then every ASCII special that can open structure or a token ( ` * _ [ ] < > # ~ | @ & ) is backslash-escaped; a dot directly followed by a letter or digit is escaped (kills www./http:// and email autolinks); per line, 4+ leading spaces/tabs are stripped (no indented code), a leading - or + list marker, a leading `N.`/`N)` ordered marker and a leading = (setext) are escaped. Line breaks, tabs and unicode pass through. CRLF normalises to LF.

cases.name: lists, ordered, setext, quote, table, strike

title._doc: titleFromReporterMessage: the issue title = the message's first non-empty line, escaped, collapsed whitespace, cut to 120 chars with an ellipsis; empty = fallback.
